assets.final_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the Z09 monitor sprite to correct. Image 2 is a STYLE AND CAMERA REFERENCE only, an oak media cabinet from the same game.
Keep Image 1's single charcoal widescreen display, compact pedestal foot, and abstract cyan wireframe graphics without any text. Change its viewpoint so it uses the same strict 2:1 dimetric camera as the cabinet reference. It must be a clean 2D illustrated sprite, not a product render.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY: the monitor's top and bottom long edges run down-right at slope +0.5, meaning 2 pixels right for every 1 pixel down, like the long cabinet edge in Image 2. The screen is therefore an obvious slanted parallelogram in image space, NOT a near-horizontal rectangle. The short visible thickness edges and the back-to-front axis of the base run down-left at slope -0.5. Vertical screen side edges stay vertical. These are orthographic parallel edges.
Maintain warm upper-left illumination, smooth illustrated charcoal surfaces, crisp thin outlines, minimal clean cyan screen elements. No desk or new objects. Center the whole monitor with generous clean padding.
Output genuine alpha transparency. Every pixel outside the object must be fully transparent, without any glow, aura, haze, cast ground shadow, room, floor or platform. No people, text, letters, numbers, watermarks or logos.

visual_qa.style: Refined 2D outlined/cel-shaded furniture, warm oak or charcoal/cyan as appropriate
visual_qa.camera: Dimetric appearance, approximate; exact +0.5/-0.5 axis compliance is not certified
visual_qa.alpha_note: Some outputs retain nearly invisible alpha=1 fringe far outside the object. Use the recorded alpha>1 bbox for geometry; PNG bytes are unmodified.

previous_attempt.reason: Selected v2 steepens screen angle toward dimetric camera; still approximate rather than exact mathematical slope.

assets.final_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE isolated game furniture sprite as a genuinely alpha-transparent PNG. Illustration should match a refined office simulator: neat thin ink contours, smooth flat cel-shaded color planes, a little warm-oak grain, charcoal and tiny cyan accents. This is 2D illustrated game art, not a product render or photorealistic image.
CRITICAL CAMERA: strict orthographic 2:1 dimetric sprite. A square horizontal footprint projects to a diamond exactly twice as wide as tall. The two world floor axes are screen vectors (2,1) and (-2,1). All straight tabletop/footprint/depth edges follow these axes, slopes +0.5 and -0.5, never shallow near-horizontal edges. Vertical edges are vertical. This same fixed overhead camera is used for every furniture piece.
Light comes from upper left. Top faces are lighter and side faces darker.
Show the whole object with all feet. One coherent complete furniture object occupies about 80% of canvas, centered with clear padding. Keep illustration details simple enough to read at a small game scale.
All empty space must have alpha zero, including gaps below furniture. Background is completely empty transparent alpha, with NO glow, NO haze, NO shadow halo, NO ground shadow, NO vignette. Do not draw any room, floor, platform, people or characters. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
SUBJECT: One compact quality-assurance dual-screen diagnostic console: two graphite monitors side-by-side attached to a single low compact warm-oak console desk with slim charcoal legs. Screen fronts clearly visible, showing abstract cyan and pale mint diagnostic lines, graph blocks and status dots, no letters or numbers. A compact charcoal keyboard is integral on the desk. No chair or extra furniture.

visual_qa.style: Refined 2D outlined/cel-shaded furniture, warm oak or charcoal/cyan as appropriate
visual_qa.camera: Dimetric appearance, approximate; exact +0.5/-0.5 axis compliance is not certified
visual_qa.alpha_note: Some outputs retain nearly invisible alpha=1 fringe far outside the object. Use the recorded alpha>1 bbox for geometry; PNG bytes are unmodified.
